_comment: LOCAL-ONLY client-credential config TEMPLATE for the rebar MCP server on the AWS box
(epic jira-reb-3527 'Enable MCP on AWS', ADR 0104 §1 — static verifier + per-client PATs).
This file is a COMMITTED, PLACEHOLDER-ONLY template. Copy it to 'mcp-clients.local.json'
(gitignored — NEVER committed) and replace each REPLACE_WITH_* placeholder with the real
per-client bearer PAT. The real PATs are the same values seeded into the SSM SecureStrings
box; keep them out of source control. Each client presents its PAT as an
'Authorization: Bearer <PAT>' header to the nginx /mcp/ TLS edge, which the box's 'static'
verifier authenticates. See infra/runbooks/mcp-client-pats.md for provisioning + rotation.
